name: task-platform
description: Two-app platform: customer (post work / find cabs) + worker (freelancer & service-firm ops). Shares a Rust/Axum backend and OTA pipeline.

scripts.//dev: ── Dev servers — start `npm run server` first in another terminal ──
scripts.//api: ── OpenAPI sync — postinstall runs this automatically ──
scripts.api:sync: npm run api:export && npm run api:codegen
scripts.postinstall: npm run api:sync --if-present || echo 'api:sync skipped (Rust unavailable) — run manually before typecheck'
scripts.//build: ── Typecheck + build (fans out to every workspace) ──
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.//native: ── Native (Capacitor) — build + cap sync + cap run ──
scripts.//release: ── One-shot OTA release: api:sync → prod build → zip bundle ──
scripts.release:ota:customer: npm run api:sync && npm run bundle:ota:prod --workspace @app/customer
scripts.release:ota:worker: npm run api:sync && npm run bundle:ota:prod --workspace @app/worker
scripts.release:ota: npm run api:sync && npm run bundle:ota:prod --workspaces --if-present
